Line extractions (`PdfLines.pages`, the engine's PDF reader) of PDFs made for these tests with Chrome's
print-to-PDF and Noto Sans Devanagari, from public-domain texts: Premchand's "ईदगाह" (Premchand died in 1936)
and Jane Austen's "Pride and Prejudice".

- `newspaper-3col.json`: an A4 newspaper-style page: headline, byline at another size, three justified
  columns with first-line indents; paragraphs run on from one column into the next.
- `mixed-hi-en.json`: two A5 pages alternating Hindi, English, Hindi with English words, and Hinglish in
  Latin script, with a running header and page numbers.
